June 19, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
Fernwood Investment Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 50.67% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fernwood Investment Management Llc sold 7,293 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 7,100 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.19M, down from 14,393 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fernwood Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $927.68B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.05% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $188.74. About 14.84 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 EPS, up 31.14% or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76 billion for 21.55 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78% negative EPS growth.
